title: LEED, BREEAM and DGNB Documentation with Fiber Cement Board: EPD Guide
description: How to use Terasun TSM fiber cement board EPD (EPD-IES-0018268) in LEED, BREEAM, and DGNB green building certification projects. Credits, documentation requirements, and specifier guidance.
author: Terasun Europe Technical Team
body:
## LEED, BREEAM, and DGNB Documentation with Fiber Cement Board

Green building certification schemes — LEED, BREEAM, and DGNB — are increasingly required on commercial, institutional, and residential projects across Europe. Specifiers need materials with verified environmental credentials. This guide explains how Terasun TSM fiber cement board supports certification documentation.

---

### Environmental Product Declaration: EPD-IES-0018268

Terasun TSM fiber cement board carries a verified **Environmental Product Declaration (EPD): EPD-IES-0018268**.

- **Standard:** ISO 14025 (Type III Environmental Declaration)
- **Scope:** Cradle-to-gate (A1–A3) with optional modules
- **Verification:** Third-party verified by an independent programme operator
- **Contents:** Global Warming Potential (GWP), Primary Energy Demand, Acidification, Eutrophication, and other impact categories per EN 15804+A2

A verified ISO 14025 EPD is the format accepted by LEED, BREEAM, and DGNB for material-level environmental declarations.

---

### LEED v4 / LEED v4.1 Credits

**MR Credit: Building Product Disclosure and Optimization — Environmental Product Declarations**

Under LEED v4 and v4.1, projects earn 1–2 points for using products with ISO 14025 Type III EPDs from at least five different manufacturers.

Terasun TSM fiber cement board with **EPD-IES-0018268** qualifies as one product contributing to this credit when installed in sufficient quantity (typically ≥0.5% by cost or quantity of total building materials).

**IEQ Credit: Low-Emitting Materials**

Fiber cement board is an inorganic, cement-based product with extremely low VOC emissions. Terasun TSM carries **REACH compliance** and **VOC/Intertek certification**, supporting Low-Emitting Materials credits.

---

### BREEAM Credits

**Mat 01: Life Cycle Impacts**

BREEAM Mat 01 awards credits for using products with EPDs as part of a whole-building Life Cycle Assessment (LCA). EPD-IES-0018268 provides the data needed for LCA software input (SimaPro, One Click LCA, etc.).

**Mat 03: Responsible Sourcing**

Fiber cement board from verified, CE-certified supply chains contributes to responsible sourcing credits. CE certification (1023-CPR-1565 P) and ETA (24/0895) demonstrate a verified, tested product supply chain.

**Hea 02: Indoor Air Quality**

Cement-based boards with low VOC emissions support indoor air quality credits when used in interior applications.

---

### DGNB Credits (Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Denmark, Czech Republic, Greece, Bulgaria)

DGNB is the dominant green building system in DACH countries. Key relevant criteria:

**ENV1.1: Life Cycle Assessment**
DGNB requires product-level EPD data for the LCA calculation. EPD-IES-0018268 provides ISO 14025 compliant data compatible with DGNB's calculation methodology (ÖKOBAUDAT database compatibility).

**ENV1.2: Local Environmental Impact**
Fiber cement board's inorganic composition means no VOC off-gassing, no formaldehyde, and no biological contamination risk — supporting this criterion.

**SOC1.2: Indoor Air Hygiene**
Terasun TSM boards contribute positively due to low emissions and inorganic composition.

---

### Fire Class Contribution to Green Building Compliance

Beyond the EPD, Terasun TSM's **A2-s1,d0** fire classification and **E120/EI90/EW120** tested wall assembly performance support:

- **BREEAM Fire Safety** credits (Hea 05 in some schemes)
- **DGNB SOC 1.6: Fire Safety** criterion
- **LEED Safety First** addenda credits for fire-rated systems

---

---

### Summary

Terasun TSM fiber cement board's **EPD-IES-0018268** (ISO 14025, third-party verified) provides the environmental data needed for LEED v4/v4.1 EPD credits, BREEAM Mat 01, and DGNB ENV1.1. Combined with its **A2-s1,d0 fire class** and **REACH/VOC certification**, it is a well-documented choice for green building projects across Europe.
